notes: Anatomical right arm and left leg are artificial; left arm and right leg are organic. Slim carbon-fibre and ivory ceramic limbs contrast with exaggerated human muscles. White faceplate with luminous eyes and mouth; no chrome.
Raster concept reference, not calibrated views from shared 3D geometry. The reusable modeling contract uses a 60,000-triangle ceiling.
title: Official reference: Hulking cyborg
